---
title: "Graphviz Basic"
# bd-ijlapt70: a plain ```dot fenced block renders as
# <pre class="graphviz"> with the escaped diagram source, plus a single
# after-body <script src> + init pair that lays the diagram out in the
# browser. The `->` arrow doubles as the HTML-escaping probe (it must
# appear as -&gt;).
#
# The runtime is BUNDLED, so the script src must be a relative path and
# no absolute URL may appear anywhere in the output. The negative
# pattern is what keeps a rendered page working offline.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["pre.graphviz"]
        - ["pre.dot", "pre.sourceCode.dot", "pre.graphviz + button"]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            "<pre class=\"graphviz\">",
            "digraph G",
            "a -&gt; b",
            "<script src=\"[^\"]*graphviz/viz-global\\.js\" charset=\"utf-8\"></script>",
            "Viz\\.instance\\(\\)",
            "querySelectorAll\\('pre\\.graphviz'\\)",
          ]
        - ["a -> b", "cdn\\.jsdelivr\\.net", "https?://"]
---

Before the diagram.

```dot
digraph G {
  a -> b
}
```

After the diagram.
